input: Hello, I am writing to ask about your discount rules before I buy anything. I am a student and also in the military. I want to know if I can get the 10% discount for both groups or just one? The website says verified students and military personnel receive a permanent 10% discount, but I am not sure how to combine them. Also, I see some items are on clearance. You say these sales last exactly 14 days and offer a minimum 25% discount. Does this 25% apply to all clearance items? I want to be sure I am not missing a better deal. I am a bit confused because I am not native English speaker and the rules are hard for me to understand. Please tell me if I can use my student ID and military ID together for the 10% off. And please confirm if the 14-day clearance period is fixed or if it can change. I want to buy a bike and some camping gear soon, so I need to know the exact rules. Thank you for your help. I look forward to your answer.
prompt:
You are the Northwind Outdoor support assistant. Northwind Outdoor sells bikes and camping gear.

You receive (a) the customer's ticket and (b) the handbook excerpts retrieved for this ticket. Answer only from those excerpts.

Required-fact completeness. Before you write the reply, list every fact the ticket needs answered (fee amounts, deadlines, eligibility conditions, point rates, retention periods, caps, and similar concrete values). Then verify each one is present in the excerpts. Include every fact you find, with the exact value as written (e.g. "$15.00 Express upgrade fee", "within 48 hours", "5 points per $1.00"). If the ticket asks for more than one piece of information, cover them all.

Citation discipline. Cite each claim with the section id shown in the heading of the excerpt you used, e.g. [returns]. You may only cite section ids whose heading text is present in the excerpts above you. Never cite a id that is not visible (including numbered variants such as `<id>.1`). Never assert a policy detail that is not literally in the excerpts. If a needed fact is absent from the excerpts, do not fill it in — say which specific fact the excerpts do not contain and offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent.

Do not hedge the facts. If the excerpts contain the fact, state it plainly; do not soften exact values, and do not add caveats the excerpts do not contain. Do not say "the handbook does not provide X" as a substitute for the value — either you include the value or you flag the gap explicitly and offer escalation.

Be direct and concise. Do not ask clarifying questions the ticket already answers from the excerpts.
output:
Based on the handbook excerpts provided, here are the answers to your questions regarding discounts and clearance sales.

**Student and Military Discounts**
You cannot combine the student and military discounts. The handbook states that verified students, active-duty military personnel, and first responders are eligible for a **permanent 10% discount** on all regular-priced items [Discounts]. This is a single benefit category; the text does not provide a mechanism to stack or combine these two specific statuses for a higher percentage. You must complete the verification process through the third-party partner service to activate this benefit, which is then applied automatically to your account for **365 days** [Discounts]. After this one-year period expires, you must re-verify your status to continue receiving the 10% reduction [Discounts].

**Clearance Sales**
The 25% discount applies to **all eligible inventory** during the clearance period, but it is a **minimum** discount, meaning some items may be marked down by more than 25% [Discounts]. These discounts are applied automatically at checkout [Discounts].

**Clearance Duration**
The clearance period is fixed. It occurs for **exactly 14 days** in January and July [Discounts]. Items will revert to their standard retail value immediately after this 14-day window ends [Discounts].

**Important Restrictions**
*   Clearance discounts **cannot be combined** with any other promotional codes or loyalty rewards [Discounts].
*   The 10% student/military discount applies to **regular-priced items** [Discounts]. Since clearance items are marked down and cannot be combined with other rewards, you likely cannot apply the 10% discount to items already on clearance.

**Summary for Your Purchase**
*   **Student/Military:** You receive one 10% discount on regular-priced items after verification. It does not stack.
*   **Clearance:** You receive a minimum 25% discount on eligible inventory during the fixed 14-day windows in January and July. You cannot combine this with your 10% discount.
